hits.snippet: Mindgard has raised USD $30 million in a Series A funding round led by Album VC, with participation from Karma Ventures and existing investors .406 Ventures, Atlantic Bridge, IQ Capital, and Lakestar. Customer demand is helping the Boston and London startup expand as enterprises race to secure AI systems against fresh attack risks. The funding comes as businesses push AI tools deeper into day-to-day operations and face greater scrutiny over the risks tied to those systems. Mindgard has seen faster deployment among Fortune 2000 companies and AI-focused businesses in sectors including financial services, pharmaceuticals, gaming, digital services, semiconductors, and healthcare. Its platform is designed to identify so-called shadow AI, carry out AI red teaming, and provide run-time protection. Mindgard argues that AI systems create a distinct attack surface that differs from traditional software security. Chief Executive Officer James Brear outlined that view in remarks accompanying the funding announcement. Investors backing the round said Mindgard has gained traction as corporate customers look for security tools tailored to AI use in production environments.
